task_description: Build a modern enterprise-grade fullstack web platform named Karya Kreatif Andalan for car rental and electric motorcycle rental services focused on online ride-hailing drivers (GOJEK, Grab, Maxim, InDrive). Monorepo with Next.js 15 frontend and NestJS backend.

verification.summary: Full monorepo build passes (3 packages: @karya/shared, @karya/api, @karya/web). Next.js generates 56 static routes. NestJS compiles all modules. Prisma db push and seed work on fresh database. 3 review iterations completed - all security issues resolved (JWT secret fail-fast, signed auth cookies, webhook validation, booking authorization, checkpoint ownership). No test suite written (greenfield scaffolding). No Dockerfile present. 162 files, ~15,000 lines of production-ready TypeScript code.
